title: Certified local firms on, or beside a firm on, the City's debarment reports
question: Is any firm in the current certified directory, or a firm it shares an address or a recorded affiliation with, named in the Controller's debarment and suspension reports or on the City's current list?
finding: 1 directory firm is named in the Controller's debarment and suspension reports: AZUL WORKS INC (reports 2020-12-31 to 2025-06-30, certified to 2028-10-31, on the current page: no). 3 more directory firms are linked to a listed firm by a shared address, telephone, email domain or contact, or by a recorded affiliation.
how: Organization names in the twelve semi-annual reports on disk (December 2020 to June 2026) and on the current City page are matched by normalised name to the directory and to each directory firm's recorded affiliates and shared-identifier partners (screen lbe-shared-identifiers). Individuals named in the reports are not matched.
limits: Being named in a report is not always a debarment: some entries are pending proceedings, stays or agreements not to seek new contracts, and a firm drops off the reports when the matter ends. Local-business certification and debarment are decided by different offices under different rules; a firm whose matter is closed may be certified. A shared address is a lead, not a tie of ownership.
